summary: Hercules Capital, Inc., a business development company, filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, covering Item 2.02 (Q2 2026 earnings press release) and Item 8.01 (declaration of a $0.47 per share quarterly cash distribution payable August 18, 2026). The filing reports record investment income and NII, leverage ratios, and liquidity. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring—is present. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
